recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composite portrait where two different male faces are bisected and joined at the center line, set against a clean white background with a blue vertical sidebar containing text and stars.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical bisection of two distinct subjects
Alignment of eyes and nose across the vertical seam
Contrast between the left subject's clean-shaven look and the right subject's headband and facial hair
Vertical text orientation on the left margin balancing the central portrait
coreInvariants: Direct eye contact from both subjects
Blue sidebar with red star accents

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The composite face is centered horizontally, filling the majority of the frame from the chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central vertical seam where the two faces meet.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the central eyes, moves down the vertical split, then shifts to the vertical text on the left sidebar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space surrounding the head to emphasize the facial features.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White (background) providing a clean, clinical contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blue (sidebar) creating a strong vertical boundary.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red (stars) and pale yellow (headband) providing small pops of color.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Natural skin tones against high-value white and high-saturation blue.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid complex gradients in the background

characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical rotation of the entire text block

composition.relationshipToImage: Contained within a dedicated color block

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold typeface used for both sidebar and advisory labels to maintain a utilitarian, urban feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and authoritative feel of the original.
Provides a cleaner, more modern grotesque look with similar proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a composite portrait of two different men, each forming half of a single face, against a plain white background. The left side should be clean-shaven; the right side should wear a light-colored headband. Include a solid blue vertical bar on the far left edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, white, condensed sans-serif text rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise inside the blue bar. Place red five-pointed stars at the top and bottom of the text string. Add a black and white rectangular advisory label in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the text in the sidebar rotated vertically?
Are the stars red and five-pointed?

adjustableVariables: Number of stars in the sidebar
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original celebrities

mustAchieve: Perfect alignment of the two face halves
Clean graphic lines in the sidebar
avoid: Blurry transition at the face seam

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the vertical text is legible despite the rotation.
Check that the eyes of both subjects are on the same horizontal plane.
Verify the blue sidebar is a solid, uniform color.
Confirm the stars are evenly spaced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine two distinct close-up portraits using a hard vertical split + place against high-key background + frame with a high-contrast vertical typographic sidebar.
